answer_result.answer: The evidence does not explicitly state that Calvin wishes to become more popular. It shows he hopes his music can reach a global audience and make an impact, and that he and a friend once talked about getting famous as teenagers, but it does not establish a current wish to become more popular.

question.question: Does Calvin wish to become more popular?

- On 2023-05-16, reconnected with Calvin ("long time no chat"); when Calvin shared that his place had flooded, Dave expressed sympathy, said the saved music gear and mic were "the important things", told Calvin to stay positive, and offered to help [S6T3][S6T4]; Dave praised Calvin's home music studio photo — "That studio looks awesome" — and said he hopes Calvin gets it fixed soon so he can keep creating [S6T5][S6T6]; when Calvin asked what he's working on, Dave excitedly told him about the shop's opening celebration (details in ## Car maintenance shop), and Calvin said he can't wait to get back to making music [S6T7][S6T8].
- The 2023-05-16 exchange continued: Calvin congratulated Dave on the shop (see ## Car maintenance shop), and when Dave asked about Calvin's music, Calvin shared the upcoming Tokyo performance [S6T10][S6T11]; Dave said doing a show in Tokyo is "wow", was sure the audience would love it, and wished him luck — Calvin promised to keep him posted on how it goes [S6T12][S6T13]; when Calvin shared a photo of the Tokyo night skyline (taken 2023-05-15), Dave called it a great shot, said the night skyline "really pops with those city lights," and said he has to take a trip to Tokyo soon [S6T14][S6T15][S6T16]; after Calvin said the city lights in Tokyo are amazing and encouraged him to visit, Dave said he is "definitely adding it to [his] list" and thanked Calvin [S6T17][S6T18].
- The 2023-06-09 conversation continued: Calvin asked what was new and exciting for Dave, and Dave announced he booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month (July 2023) — "finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks" (details in ## Mountain trip (July 2023)) [S8T10]. Calvin said he wants to go on a hike in the mountains to escape it all and de-stress — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Mountains and hiking [S8T9]. The two exchanged trip wishes and signed off "see you soon" [S8T11][S8T12][S8T13][S8T14].

Take care and keep creating amazing music!"; Calvin accepted the offer ("I'll definitely take you up on that offer") and re-pledged to let Dave know when he's in Boston; the chat closed with mutual goodbyes — Dave: "Thanks again for your help. I'm glad that I can make people happy and that's what I'm gonna keep doing." — and had to go, "I have a lot of work to do! Take care!" [S19T11]; the conversation closed with Calvin: "You're really talented, Dave. Keep making people happy and doing what you love. That's what it's all about. See you soon, have a nice one!" [S19T12].

(song details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Sounds great, Cal! 'California Love' is a classic! Let me know if you wanna jam some music together!" — inviting Calvin to jam some music together (details in ## Music); Calvin: "Yeah, let's do it! That would be awesome."; Dave: "I'm stoked, Calvin! We can crank up the music and have an awesome jam session. Can't wait!"; Calvin: "Yeah, Dave! Gonna be great! Can't wait to see what we can do."; Dave: "Yeah, let's do it! It'll be awesome. Let's rock it!"; Calvin: "Yeah, let's do this! I can't wait!"; the conversation closed with Dave: "Nice one, Calvin! Let's make some awesome memories and have a great time. See ya soon!", and Calvin: "Count me in. Can't wait to create something special. See you soon!", and Dave's final parting: "Yep, Calvin! Can't wait to see you soon. Take it easy till then." - On 2023-10-04, caught up with Calvin ("Hey Dave!"): Calvin told him he met with "incredible" artists in Boston the day before (2023-10-03) and talked about working together, and is stoked to collaborate with them on new music (details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Awesome, Calvin! Connecting with all those talented artists must have been an inspiring experience. Can't wait to hear what you come up with in your collaboration. Let me know how it goes!" and asked how Calvin arranged the meeting; Calvin: it was through their mutual friend who "knew we'd be a great fit," and "Can't wait to show you the final result." The chat then turned to relaxing hobbies: Calvin said he loves working on a car project "to chill out" and shared a photo of a shiny orange car with its hood open; Dave: "Wow, Calvin, that car looks great! Working on cars really helps me relax, it's therapeutic to see them come back to life" and told him he's been restoring the Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard — "it was in bad shape, but I knew it had potential" (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin: "It's awesome that you can bring things back to life" and asked for photos of it looking amazing; Dave shared a photo of a red car parked in a field with other cars — "I put in a lot of work restoring it, but the result is awesome. It's so satisfying to bring an old car back to life." Calvin: "We've been greatly privileged to have been granted this opportunity. It's so satisfying to bring it back to life!" and shared a photo of dirty hands next to a car; Dave shared a photo of his hands after a day in the garage — "permanently stained with grease. But it's worth it when you see the end result."; Calvin: "Yeah, Dave! Those hands show you worked hard. You put in lots of effort. You should definitely be proud!", and Dave thanked him, saying he loves being able to transform something old and beat-up into something beautiful and that it's the small successes that make him feel proud and fulfilled (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose); the two closed the chat with mutual encouragement — both agreed it's motivating and inspiring to see the progress and development in their projects and in themselves, that hard work, dedication, and determination are key to reaching their goals and potential and what sets them apart, and that they'll never give up and keep pushing for more — Calvin: "Let's never give up and keep striving for success... Onwards to our goals!" and Dave: "It's really motivating and keeps me pushing for more." and "Let's keep going! We won't lose focus on our goals. Hard work and determination will get us there. Let's do this!"; the chat then closed with final goodbyes — Calvin: "Yeah, let's do it! Let's stay focused and work hard to make our dreams happen. We can make it happen together! Wishing you all the best until we meet again!" and Dave: "Yep, Calvin! Together, we can do amazing things if we work together and stay motivated. We got this! Take care and stay well!" - On 2023-10-08, caught up with Calvin ("Hey Calvin! What's up?"): told him that last Friday (2023-10-06) he went to a car show — saw some awesome cars, got to mess with car mods, and there were so many cool machines around — "it was so much fun!" — and shared a photo of "this beautiful car" (a photography of two men looking at a car engine); Calvin: "Hey Dave, that sounds awesome! I'm into the rush of awesome cars. Can't wait to check out your garage." (shared a photo of a red sports car parked in a showroom) [S22T1][S22T2]. Dave: "Thanks! Yeah, this one looks great!" and said he restored and modified the car himself, adding a custom exhaust and some performance upgrades — it's "got a sweet sound" and he's "really proud of how it turned out"; Calvin: "Wow, Dave! You really turned it into a masterpiece. Impressive!" (shared a photo of a car driving down a street with a traffic light) [S22T3][S22T4]. Dave: "Thanks Calvin! I've spent a lot of time and effort on it. It's not just a hobby, it's a passion. It's like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress." and added that as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage tinkering with engines — "it was like my own sanctuary" — and now he's "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome" (details in ## Classic cars and ## Hobbies and sense of purpose); Calvin: "Wow, Dave, that's amazing. Bringing broken things back to life is so satisfying. Working on cars can be a real escape from reality, and I understand that feeling. Doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal, right? Keep going with it, it's really inspiring." [S22T5][S22T6]. Dave: "Thanks, Calvin. It's been my goal since I was a kid and it's awesome to be able to do something I love. Restoring things like this can be tough but the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great. Absolutely, I'm loving it." Calvin: "Go for it, Dave! Chasing your dreams is what life's about. It's awesome to see how far you've come. Keep working hard and living your best life." (Calvin's side of this whole exchange in the 2023-10-08 entry of ## Relationships in /memories/calvin.md) [S22T7][S22T8].
